name: Windows Hardening Assessment
description: Focused assessment of Windows system hardening configurations. Covers Group Policy security settings, Microsoft Defender Antivirus and Attack Surface Reduction rules, Credential Guard and LSA protection, WDAC and AppLocker policy assessment, Windows Firewall configuration, BitLocker and encryption configuration, Windows Event Forwarding, account policies, and CIS Windows Benchmark compliance.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Windows hardening assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Windows hardening principles and security baseline concepts
evidence: Can explain Group Policy security settings, Microsoft Defender features, and UAC
Familiar with CIS Windows Server and Windows 11 Enterprise Benchmark structure
Understands Credential Guard, LSA protection, and WDAC at a conceptual level
Completed introductory training on Windows security hardening

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs Windows hardening assessment tools and reviews configurations under supervision
evidence: Runs CIS-CAT, Microsoft Security Compliance Toolkit, or equivalent under guidance
Reviews Group Policy settings against CIS benchmarks using checklists
Assesses Windows Firewall rules, account policies, and audit policy configuration
Documents findings with supervision and produces basic hardening reports

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Windows hardening and provides contextualized remediation
evidence: Independently assesses Windows servers and workstations against CIS benchmarks
Evaluates Credential Guard, WDAC/AppLocker, and ASR rule configurations
Assesses BitLocker configuration including TPM and recovery key management
Produces compliant hardening assessment reports with risk-prioritized remediation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom Windows hardening baselines; handles complex environments
evidence: Develops organization-specific Group Policy baselines for different server roles
Assesses complex environments with mixed Windows versions and domain configurations
Evaluates Microsoft Defender for Endpoint configuration and exclusion security
Reviews hardening assessment work of junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Windows hardening methodology; contributes to industry standards
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Windows hardening assessment framework
Contributes to CIS Benchmark development for Windows platforms
Trains teams on advanced Windows hardening across Server and Desktop editions
Recognized as authority on Windows security baseline configuration

assessment_methods.description: Assess a set of Windows servers and workstations with varying hardening levels and produce a prioritized findings report with Windows-specific remediation
Review Windows hardening assessment findings and remediation guidance from recent engagements
